goal: Improve story completion and rewatch potential without sacrificing clarity
audience: English-speaking international kids and families; family-friendly
brand_guidelines: VOX: cinematic mini-stories, clear character action, simple spoken English, no filler, original characters and original music only
success_metric: Comparable 7-day average percentage viewed, completion rate and rewatch rate
content: Title: The Missing Star. Hook: A small robot can't find its favourite star. The robot looks under a bed, in a box, and in the garden. At the end, the star is reflected in its own shiny chest. Narration: The star was with him all along. Visuals: 5 shots, 30 seconds.
